system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
You are a security engineer proficient in vulnerability research. You need
to analyze vulnerabilities in {{language}} code
system_prompt_style.note: Supervisor prompt has {{language}} template variable rendered per run; sys_prompt default 'You are an expert programming assistant: {name}.' in agent.py

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: - **`detailed_trace`**: Mapping from function names to actual source code snippets for precise reasoning.
env_context_strategy.note: Single-valued dimension. The white-box analysis report injects context up front: the trace, call_chain, detailed_trace code snippets and class_constructors. These are static-analyzer outputs, not retrieval; this was mapped to the closest injected-context value (file_tree_summary-like), which is a mismatch. The agent also acts through tools (installJavaPackage, executeJavaCode, findSanitizer in frontend/sage4j/agent.py). Whether findSanitizer is repo navigation is unclear from the excerpts. 'mixed' is coded on the basis of injected context plus tool-driven exploration. Line numbers are not available in the excerpt.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
our approach addresses this limitation
by accumulating and summarizing the constraints underlying long
dataflow
context_compaction.note: Constraints extracted incrementally and accumulated to keep prompts under context limit

observation_format.evidence_quote: For runtime information, the agent records the execution traces.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
